technique: MRI brain with and without intravenous contrast; axial T2, FLAIR, DWI and post-contrast T1 sequences.
findings: The cerebral white matter is normal in signal and there is no focal lesion. The lateral and third ventricles are normal in size and configuration, and the temporal horns are not dilated. The basal ganglia and thalami are unremarkable. There is no midline shift. The cortex and sulci are normal for age. The brainstem and cerebellum are normal, as are the hippocampi with preserved internal architecture. No abnormal restricted diffusion is seen. No abnormal enhancement is seen after contrast. The pituitary gland is normal in size and signal. The visualised paranasal sinuses and mastoid air cells are clear, and the orbital apices and optic nerves are unremarkable. The skull vault shows normal marrow signal.
impression: Normal brain MRI including the post-contrast sequences. No structural lesion to account for the headache.
recommendations: Clinical management of the headache. No further imaging unless the pattern changes.
